It says the order drops within a time of about 1/J and then levels off. It says the order stays above zero because a 6-spin chain is small, and that is a fair finite-size point. It ties the effect to the reduced ordered moment in KCuF3. Calling the chains a quantum spin liquid is loose wording, because physicists usually describe a spinon continuum. The core physics is still correct.
